title: WHERE with text, ORDER BY, LIMIT
explanation: WHERE works with text too, but text goes inside single quotes, like 'RPG'. LIKE finds text that matches a pattern: % means 'anything can go here', so '%Mario%' finds any title with Mario in it. IN is a shortcut for checking a list: genre IN ('RPG', 'Action') means genre is RPG or Action. ORDER BY sorts your results: ASC is smallest to biggest (or A to Z), and DESC is biggest to smallest. LIMIT keeps only the first few rows. Order matters: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, then LIMIT last.

example.code:
SELECT title, rating
FROM games
WHERE genre IN ('RPG', 'Action')
ORDER BY rating DESC
LIMIT 2;

lines.explain: Show me the title and rating columns.
Only keep games whose genre is in this list: RPG or Action. Text goes in single quotes.
Sort by rating, highest first. DESC means biggest to smallest.

tasks.prompt: Show the title of every game with 'Mario' anywhere in its name.
tasks.answer: SELECT title FROM games WHERE title LIKE '%Mario%';
hints: Use LIKE with a pattern. The % sign means 'anything can go here'.

solution_lines.explain: Keep titles with Mario anywhere in them. The % on each side means anything can come before or after.

tasks.prompt: Show the title and genre of every game whose genre is Shooter or RPG. Use IN.
tasks.answer: SELECT title, genre FROM games WHERE genre IN ('Shooter', 'RPG');
hints: IN checks a list of values. Remember the single quotes around text.

solution_lines.explain: Show me the title and genre columns.
Keep games whose genre is in the list: Shooter or RPG.

tasks.prompt: Show the title and rating of every game, highest rating first.
tasks.answer: SELECT title, rating FROM games ORDER BY rating DESC;
hints: Sorting uses ORDER BY. Highest first means biggest to smallest.

solution_lines.explain: Show me the title and rating columns.
Sort by rating, biggest to smallest. Blank (NULL) ratings end up at the bottom.

tasks.prompt: Show the first 5 game titles in alphabetical order (A to Z).
tasks.answer: SELECT title FROM games ORDER BY title ASC LIMIT 5;
hints: Sort by title A to Z, then keep only the first few rows.

solution_lines.explain: Sort titles A to Z. ASC means smallest to biggest.

tasks.prompt: Show the title and price of Shooter or Simulation games that cost less than 20, sorted by title A to Z.
tasks.answer: SELECT title, price FROM games WHERE genre IN ('Shooter', 'Simulation') AND price < 20 ORDER BY title ASC;
hints: Mix IN with a number filter from Lesson 2 using AND, then sort.
WHERE genre IN ('Shooter', 'Simulation') AND price < 20 ORDER BY title ASC

solution_lines.explain: Show me the title and price columns.
Keep games that are Shooter or Simulation AND cost less than 20.
Sort the results A to Z by title.

recap: You just learned to filter text with LIKE and IN, sort with ORDER BY (ASC or DESC), and keep only the top rows with LIMIT.
